title: "Cheat sheet"
subtitle: "Formulas and rules of thumb"
---

## Formulas

- Mean squared error: $L = \frac{1}{n}\sum_i (\hat{y}_i - y_i)^2$
- Gradient step: $\theta \leftarrow \theta - \eta \nabla L$
- Ridge objective: $\|Xw - y\|^2 + \lambda\|w\|^2$

## Rules of thumb

- Always keep a ==held-out test set== — no exceptions
- Diverging loss → learning rate too large
- Great train / poor test accuracy → overfitting: simplify or regularize
- Tune hyperparameters on a **validation** split, never the test set

## Takeaway box

Use `.takeaway` for the one sentence students should retain from the slide:

::: {.takeaway}
One slide, one key message.
:::

Add `.dark` for white text on a black fill:

::: {.takeaway .dark}
One slide, one key message.
:::

## Table rules

Wrap a table in `.table-style` to set its rules and header alignment:

::: {.table-style first-col-rule="3px" col-rules="all" head-rule="3px" head-align="center"}
| Metric | Meaning | Formula |
|---|---|:---:|
| **Accuracy** | correct predictions over all predictions | $\dfrac{TP+TN}{TP+FP+FN+TN}$ |
| **Precision** | true among those predicted positive | $\dfrac{TP}{TP+FP}$ |
| **Recall** | found among those actually positive | $\dfrac{TP}{TP+FN}$ |
:::
